description.text: To meet the needs of foreign universities, educational institutions and other organizations, the courses are organized for groups of students (above 10). A flexible curriculum is offered, lasting from 2-10 weeks. StudentCategories TuitionRates(RMB) Short-TermChineseTraining&CultureUnderstandingProgram ChineseCultureCourses(3hours/day) 35/hour CultureTrip Dependingonrouteandprogram Generally the program consists of two parts: Campus Courses and Culture Trip. (1) Campus Courses:Basic Chinese, Speaking, Listening, Chinese Calligraphy and Painting, Chinese Kong Fu (including shadowboxing), Chinese Folk Musical Instruments, Chinese National Music, Songs, Dance and special lectures on Chinese Culture, Chinese History and the Business Environment in China (in English, Thai, or Vietnamese). (2) Culture Trip: Discover Yunnan Tour: Kunming – Dali – Lijiang – Shangri-la, travel on Yunnan highlands and explore pristine nature. Magnificent Yunnan Tour: Kunming –Dali - Baoshan–Tengchong, travel to hot springs, volcanoes and to travel across the Eastern Grand Canyon.Mysterious Yunnan Tour: Kunming –Simao –Xishuangbanna, travel to tropical rainforest and get an understanding of ethnic minority culture. Kunming Neighouring Suburbs Leisure Tour: Visit cultural and historical spots, view beautiful urban and rural scenery, and enjoy delicious Chinese food.The tour route can be modified upon the request of different groups.

duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Training and Culture Understanding Programs at Kunming University of Science and Technology is a 10 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4 USD/In total ￥ 35 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.
